parameters.name: JodId
parameters.description: The job ID. Refer to [ListJobs](~~459676~~) to obtain the job ID.

parameters.name: TensorboardId
parameters.description: The Tensorboard ID. Refer to [ListTensorboards](~~459689~~) to obtain the Tensorboard ID.

parameters.name: Token
parameters.description: The sharing token. Specify this parameter to use the sharing token to obtain the permission to view a specific Tensorboard job. You can extract the token from the URL returned by calling [GetTensorboardSharedUrl](~~2557813~~).

parameters.name: WorkspaceId
parameters.description: The workspace ID. <props="china">Refer to [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~) to obtain the workspace ID.</props>.
